daily.title: Daily Routine
steps: Open the system as soon as you start — your attendance is logged automatically
Check "Follow-ups" first: today's appointments have priority — clients you promised
Then "My Clients Today": call one by one — don't skip around
Visits during field peak hours (10am–1pm · 4pm–7pm)
End of day: open "My Performance" and confirm you hit your target before closing

call.title: The Cold Call
call.goal: The goal: a meeting — in-person first
steps: Open the client in the system and press "Call" — the timer documents it
First 10 seconds: your name + Omnira Valet + reason for the call in one sentence
One value proposition only: "We organize your parking and elevate the reception experience — no management headache"
Ask for the meeting as a choice: "I'll stop by for 15 minutes — tomorrow morning or afternoon?"
Objection? Answer once then return to asking for the meeting. Can't? Take a specific follow-up time
Close the call with a clear outcome — the system won't accept anything less

visit.title: The Field Visit
visit.goal: Full proof + a chance at an immediate meeting
steps: Before arriving: prepare the profile and offer on your phone (content library)
On arrival: photo of the place + location capture + selfie — before anything else
Ask for the decision maker by name — don't pitch someone who can't decide
Offer 15 minutes now, or book a meeting with a specific time
Fill out the full form + your notes before leaving the site — don't postpone

meeting.title: The Meeting
meeting.goal: The close — or a next step with a date
steps: Confirm the appointment an hour before — call or message
Bring with you: the profile + offer + price quote generator ready
Listen first: lot size, their current headache, then present the fitting solution
Present the price from the generator in front of them — instant transparency
Don't leave without: a contract or a next step with a specific date

rules.title: The Golden Rules
steps: No client without an outcome: meeting, appointment, or archive with a reason
In-person before online — always try in-person first
Log instantly in the system — don't postpone logging to end of day
Notes are your memory: write the contact's name and what they said after every interaction
Follow-ups are promises — if you promised a client a time, call exactly then
